shortfall.statement: the bf16 dose shortfall is at most 13% (mean of per-position ratios) and 25% (ratio of mean norms) on the decisive tasks, against a fold drop at alpha 2 of connected components 20.3x, shortest path 6.2x, two sum 0.6x, grid 3.0x, kth smallest 1.6x (correct-only shares, Haldane +0.5); the cause is not established: engine, GPU, kernel and sampler streams all differ (Claim E decides it)
